purpose: Test whether even the optimistic local clean receiver path can fit the Aerial testMAC UL indication threshold.
claim_boundary: This is neither a production d_MAC qualification nor a WCET bound. It omits MPS, external AI, IPC, controller RPC, real DU release timing, and real channels.
order: NeuralRx then conventional recovery in each iteration
decision_rule: Report receiver-alone and wait-then-recover wall-time counts at 4.5 ms; do not promote any sample statistic to a bound.
